---

## Backend Directory Exploration Report

### 1. API Route Files

| File Path | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `/home/admin/backend/routes/api.php` | Main API routes under `/api/v1/` (auth, students, classes, attendance, billing, finance, etc.) |
| `/home/admin/backend/routes/web.php` | SPA fallback: serves `index.html` for non-API routes |
| `/home/admin/backend/routes/console.php` | Console/CLI routes (Laravel default) |

---

### 2. Controller Files and Summaries

| Path | Summary |
|------|---------|
| `app/Http/Controllers/AuthController.php` | Login, register, `me`, `updateMe`. Handles email/username + password, issues AuthToken. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/StudentController.php` | CRUD for students. List by campus/name/grade, bind RFID card, import/export. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/StudentClassController.php` | CRUD for student classes (courses). Session dates, sync, confirm payment, session deduction. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/AttendanceController.php` | Attendance list, ended sessions, swipe. Manages `StudentSignIn` records. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php` | CRUD for learning records. Approve, reject, request changes, reschedule, batch approve. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ScheduleController.php` | CRUD for schedules. Filter by branch, student, teacher, status, day_of_week. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/AlertController.php` | Tuition alerts: courses with low remaining sessions or unpaid. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/FinanceController.php` | Finance: summary, revenue, outstanding, teacher payroll, subject units. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/BillingController.php` | Invoices CRUD, record payments, export. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/CampusController.php` | List campuses (branches). `listPublic` for registration (no auth). |
| `app/Http/Controllers/RoomController.php` | CRUD for rooms (name, capacity, campus_id, memo, is_active). |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ProfileController.php` | Teachers/directors visible to user’s campus. CRUD for profiles. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ParentPortalController.php` | Parent login (ID+phone or name+phone), LINE login, dashboard, leave request, payment message. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/SwipeRfidController.php` | RFID swipe endpoint. Receives branch_code + rfid, creates student/teacher sign-in. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/LineWebhookController.php` | LINE webhook. Handles follow/unfollow, messages. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/BackfillController.php` | Backfill: register subject units (ClassSession + LearningRecord) for date range. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ResetDataController.php` | Super admin only. Clears courses, students, teachers; keeps super_admin. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/PendingSwipeController.php` | Unknown RFID swipes. List, assign student, match to class, delete. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/TempRfidController.php` | Temporary RFID: show recent (5 min) per campus, consume. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/TeacherBranchController.php` | Teacher–branch assignments (UserCampus). Index, store, destroy. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/DirectorAccountController.php` | Director self-register (public), super_admin approve/reject pending. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ImportController.php` | Import students and student classes from Excel/CSV. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ExportController.php` | Export students, student classes, invoices to Excel. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/ApiClientController.php` | API clients per campus. Create, revoke, list. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/TeacherController.php` | List teachers by campus (not used in `api.php`; teachers via ProfileController). |
| `app/Http/Controllers/Controller.php` | Base controller (AuthorizesRequests, DispatchesJobs, ValidatesRequests). |
